title: Oscar Marco, violinist
summary: Oscar Marco's violin style is compared to Joe Venuti.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Yes, he was a fine violinist. Oscar Marco played really, really great violin. I can remember him playing fine violin. His brother Mickey Marco was a very good pianist too.
Is there anybody that Oscar Marco played like? Anybody that compared with him?

Yes, I would compare Oscar to, I would say that he played along the lines of Joe Benuti in those days. He played that similar type of jazz. I mean, he played a real nice, hot style of violin. Something that you don't hear too much, you know. He played definitely along, I would say definitely along the lines of Joe Benuti. As much as I can remember.
